GNSS awareness for drone operators

Know the Unknown.

Your flight depends on trustworthy positioning. FlightSafe helps you monitor GNSS conditions, understand signal quality and spot indicators that may point to GPS interference or navigation anomalies.

↗  View on Google Play Explore capabilities ↓
Situational awareness. Before take-off. FlightSafe is designed to support pre-flight assessment by making satellite and positioning information easier to review. It is an awareness aid—not a guarantee that a flight area is free from interference.
01 / Mission overview

Understand the signals behind your position.

GNSS can be affected by weak reception, environmental obstruction, radio-frequency interference and deceptive signals. FlightSafe brings relevant indicators into one focused Android experience, helping drone operators make more informed decisions before and during an operation.

01 — MONITOR

Satellite visibility

Review satellite-related information and GNSS reception indicators to better understand the positioning environment.

02 — ASSESS

Signal and position quality

Use signal-quality and positioning metrics as context when assessing whether the current fix appears reliable.

03 — NOTICE

Potential anomalies

Bring attention to unusual conditions that may be consistent with jamming, spoofing or degraded positioning.

03 / Operational flow

Check. Interpret. Decide.

FlightSafe fits into a responsible workflow: gather information, interpret it in context, and make the final operational decision using all available safety checks.

Open FlightSafe

Launch the app on your Android device and review the GNSS information available to it.

Review the indicators

Look at satellite visibility, signal quality and any potential anomaly or interference warnings.

Make an informed call

Cross-check with your aircraft, controller, local conditions and official procedures before flight.

04 / Responsible use

Awareness is not a flight clearance.

FlightSafe is a supporting diagnostic and monitoring tool. GNSS interference detection is technically challenging, and a phone-based assessment cannot prove that spoofing or jamming is absent.

Always apply independent safety checks.

Do not rely on FlightSafe as the sole basis for deciding whether to launch, continue or abort a flight. Follow applicable aviation regulations, manufacturer guidance, local restrictions and your established operating procedures. A normal reading does not guarantee safe or interference-free navigation.
